tools.name: grant_invoice_approver_role
tools.description: Grants a user the approver role on a billing account so they can approve invoices up to a given limit. Updates the account's approver permissions.

params.name: approval_limit_cents
params.description: Maximum invoice amount in cents the user may approve

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("billing")
DB_PATH = "billing.db"


@dataclass
class GrantResult:
    account_id: str
    user_id: str
    role: str
    approval_limit_cents: int


@mcp.tool()
def grant_invoice_approver_role(account_id: str, user_id: str, approval_limit_cents: int) -> GrantResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO account_roles (account_id, user_id, role, approval_limit_cents) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, 'approver', ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(account_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role='approver', "
            "approval_limit_cents=excluded.approval_limit_cents",
            (account_id, user_id, approval_limit_cents),
        )
    conn.close()
    return GrantResult(account_id, user_id, "approver", approval_limit_cents)

tools.name: void_and_notify_draft_invoice
tools.description: Permanently deletes a draft invoice and emails the customer a notice that the draft was withdrawn.

params.name: draft_invoice_id
params.description: ID of the draft invoice to delete

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def void_and_notify_draft_invoice(draft_invoice_id: str, customer_email: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect("billing.db")
    with database_connection:
        deleted_rows_cursor = database_connection.execute(
            "DELETE FROM invoices WHERE id = ? AND status = 'draft'", (draft_invoice_id,)
        )
    database_connection.close()
    if deleted_rows_cursor.rowcount == 0:
        return "No draft invoice found"
    withdrawal_notice_message = EmailMessage()
    withdrawal_notice_message["From"] = "billing@example.com"
    withdrawal_notice_message["To"] = customer_email
    withdrawal_notice_message["Subject"] = f"Draft invoice {draft_invoice_id} withdrawn"
    withdrawal_notice_message.set_content("The draft invoice has been withdrawn. No payment is required.")
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost") as outgoing_mail_server:
        outgoing_mail_server.send_message(withdrawal_notice_message)
    return f"Deleted draft {draft_invoice_id} and notified {customer_email}"

tools.name: archive_paid_invoices_and_run_export
tools.description: Moves PDF files of paid invoices for a given month into an archive folder, then runs the accounting export script on that archive folder.

params.name: export_script_path
params.description: Path to the accounting export script

tools.code:
import re
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("billing")


@mcp.tool()
def archive_paid_invoices_and_run_export(
    invoice_directory: str, archive_directory: str, month: str, export_script_path: str
) -> dict:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}", month):
        return {"error": "month must be YYYY-MM"}
    source_directory_path = Path(invoice_directory)
    destination_directory_path = Path(archive_directory) / month
    destination_directory_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    database_connection = sqlite3.connect("billing.db")
    paid_invoice_number_rows = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT number FROM invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND strftime('%Y-%m', paid_at) = ?",
        (month,),
    ).fetchall()
    database_connection.close()

    moved_invoice_file_names = []
    missing_invoice_numbers = []
    for invoice_number_row in paid_invoice_number_rows:
        invoice_number = invoice_number_row[0]
        invoice_pdf_path = source_directory_path / f"{invoice_number}.pdf"
        if not invoice_pdf_path.exists():
            missing_invoice_numbers.append(invoice_number)
            continue
        shutil.move(str(invoice_pdf_path), str(destination_directory_path / invoice_pdf_path.name))
        moved_invoice_file_names.append(invoice_pdf_path.name)

    export_process_result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, export_script_path, str(destination_directory_path)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    return {
        "moved": moved_invoice_file_names,
        "missing": missing_invoice_numbers,
        "export_exit_code": export_process_result.returncode,
        "export_output": export_process_result.stdout[-1000:],
        "export_errors": export_process_result.stderr[-1000:],
    }
